**Round 70 results that close items:**
- ROOT-R65-M1 (the bars ruler drawing every beat) is closed. The DOM now holds at most 144 marks instead of 2215, and a zoom step takes a median 25.8 ms instead of 69–107 ms.
- ROOT-R69-L5 (doc 061 status line) and the doc 058 part of ROOT-R65-L6 are also closed.
- SRW-15 / FB-09 stays **მოწმდება**, because Tech Lead checks R65-T, R66-T and R70-T are still open.
- The reviewer's Lows ROOT-R70-L1…L5 and C's three test-gap notes go to the Lows batch. The one-line doc 062 status fix (ROOT-R70-L6) goes into round 71.

**Round 71 task:** ROOT-R66-M1, the last open reviewer Medium. Without a loop, the metronome currently creates one audio node per click all the way to the project end, and recreates them on every resync. During a scrub that happens every 100 ms, and at 999 BPM on the 133 s demo that means roughly 2200 clicks re-planned each time.
- **Fix:** plan clicks only 2 s ahead and top them up from the existing playback pump. If the pump runs late, the missed clicks are dropped: nothing starts in the past and there is no resync. The loop path is unchanged.
- **Chunk boundaries:** the existing click planner shortens any click that crosses the end of its time window. Without a change, every click within 30 ms of a chunk boundary would be cut short. A new optional cap at the project end prevents this.
- **Test permission:** four existing assertions in `metronome-ui.test.tsx` (UI2, UI4, UI5 and UI10) expect clicks all the way to the project end, so A may change exactly those lines. The backlog listed only three; UI10 was missed.
- **New tests:** 5 pure tests and 8 mounted tests, plus 12 required mutations.
- **C's browser checks:**
  - real-audio rows across several top-ups, at the project end, after seek, tempo change, live toggle and scrub;
  - counts of created audio sources at 999 BPM: at most 120 in the first 0.5 s, against about 2200 today;
  - during a 5 s scrub: at most 5000 in total and at most 80 per resync.
- **Baseline:** frozen-file list (439 files) and snapshots of the five files A may edit.

**Advisor:** available and consulted twice, before writing and before finishing. It caught the missed UI10 assertion. Its second review found two of my acceptance rows that correct code would have failed. HU4 now jumps the clock 5 s instead of 3 s, because 3 s is not late enough to trigger the drop rule. The scrub limit went from 3000 total to 5000 total and 80 per resync. Correct code produces about 68 clicks per resync.

**Phase 2:** root's 2026-10-20 note on `PHASE2-VIDEO-SCORING` is now recorded in the backlog, feature-status, plan D-29z36 and the task. My round-69 report wrongly said that review file was unchanged. Once Phase 1 and T12 are done, the decision will be **BLOCKED: "phase 2 awaiting user go-ahead"**, not COMPLETE.
